info.name: ACME Incident API - Regression Tests
info.description:
An ordered run with assertions, covering authentication, role permissions, the incident workflow, notes, scoping and all seven reports.

**Run it, do not click through it.** The requests depend on each other: ids and tokens are captured into collection variables as it goes. Use the Collection Runner, or Newman:

```
newman run postman/ACME-Incident-API.regression.postman_collection.json \
  -e postman/Local.postman_environment.json
```

It is safe to run repeatedly: every record it creates carries a run id, and the last folder removes them.

It expects the seeded development database, with the accounts `admin@acme.inc`, `asha@acme.inc` and `eng.hvac@acme.inc`, all using the password `Passw0rd!`.
